title: Golf championship billboard
slide_intent: Test brand expression at advertising scale because sponsorship must be identifiable within a larger event message.
strategic_value: Circular linework and a compact mark can connect event photography to the parent identity.

practical_value: Inspect graphic restraint when an event image carries most of the message.
